fusions.name: Drawn Seine
fusions.desc: Hauls a net of strands through a cone ahead of you that deals 4 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Landed Catch
fusions.desc: Casts a line of hair that deals 14 damage to one enemy within 7 tiles and stuns it for 1 second, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Knot
fusions.desc: For 7 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Tangled Minnow
fusions.desc: A bonded fish woven from your strands swims beside you, striking an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
